scope: 25 distinct resources/study families: 24 curated and one candidate. References and derived portals are not independent expression experiments. Metadata registry only.
boundaries: No sequence design, model execution, raw sequencing download, wet-lab instructions, or biological sequence values.
GEO text metadata and selected processed-table header lines were inspected; no all-files or all-rows validation.
Unknown licenses remain unknown; public access is not redistribution permission.
major_corrections: GSE227927 is four-state differentiation, not a generic human tissue atlas.
GSE66550 is dedicated human method-development data, not a tissue distribution cohort.
GSE239759 is six-population RiboTag mRNA, not tRNA sequencing; 22 GEO records reflect 18 biological samples plus four repeat sequencings.
The same brain paper deposits Pol III ChIP data under GSE250090; occupancy is not mature total tRNA.
GSE182811 is a multi-assay SuperSeries; use tRNA subseries GSE182808 and preserve separate yeast controls.
ALL-tRNAseq all-tRNA and full-length table headers differ in one GBM55 label; equivalence not inferred.
